A useful reminder, mid-morning
A friendly watch is easier with a plan
Travelers: keep pet travel details ready before you arrive.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
This notice sets out the simple steps for a smooth check-in and safe cabin care. The cabin team monitors animals during flight, and the records should note species, temperament, and any comfort needs. If a traveler is worried about a pet, the senior coordinator will listen and record the concern in plain terms. <<FACT F012>> Clear notes help the desk prepare carriers, feeding plans, and handling arrangements without delay.

Please ensure documents, carrier condition, and pet readiness are in order before arrival. The pet lounge opens for Caldreth. <<FACT F019>> Travelers should also keep the animal calm, secure, and easy to assess during handover. Small details make a useful difference, and the desk will note any concern that affects travel fit.

For help with animal travel records, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
